summary: Two DB-008 objects routed to the artist agent cannot be fixed by the artist lane because every real consumer file is outside the artist working set (docs/engineering/agents/artist/WORKING_SET.json) and outside the Wave 34 artist file ownership. (1) The code-drift cluster "events": event_posts, marketplace_post_attachments, job_posting_templates.application_form_template (47 diagnostic hits). (2) The `bookings` relation from the artist cluster: the inventory's attribution to app/api/artist-jobs/[id]/applications/route.ts is not reproducible, and the only real consumers are app/api/analytics/route.ts and app/api/calendar/me/route.ts. There is no `events` agent in docs/engineering/agents/registry.yaml and no manifest entry for app/api/events/**, lib/events/**, app/api/analytics/** or app/api/calendar/**, so these files are unowned. The artist lane did not edit them. Orchestrator action: route the files to an owning lane or extend a lane's working set.
